cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No tickets sold? Excellent, a full technical rehearsal. Give me the opening line at performance volume, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The theatre's cancelled us and kept the deposit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. We can rehearse outdoors and learn to project properly. Face the square, not the wall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's closed for roadworks. All we can afford is the bus home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, a moving audience. Start your speech after the stop announcement. After it, please; we finally have a sound cue worth respecting.
